definitions.explanation: A work of considerable length, typically used for novels, films, and other creative works. Contrasts with 短編 (short work) and 中編 (medium-length work).

examples.japanese: {長編|ちょうへん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長編|ちょうへん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This director's feature film is three hours long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長編|ちょうへん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: A writer who gained popularity with short stories attempted their first full-length novel.

notes:
USAGE:
{長編|ちょうへん} is a prefix-like noun that modifies other nouns to indicate full or extended length. It is most commonly paired with ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel), ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (film), and ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ (manga).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ (short work — short story, short film)
- ⟦{中編|ちゅうへん}→中編：19271_chuuhen⟧ (medium-length work — novella)
- {長編|ちょうへん} (full-length work — novel, feature film)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長編|ちょうへん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (full-length novel)
- {長編|ちょうへん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (feature-length film)
- {長編|ちょうへん}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ (feature-length anime)
- {長編|ちょうへん}⟦{大作|たいさく}→大作：12196_taisaku⟧ (full-length masterwork)
